tutorial.scope: Isolated measured start positions; actual keyboard helm/deployment; actual simulated search/catch. No physical controller or device acceptance.

records.name: old-approach-rejected
records.lesson:
Frank · 5/10 · Find the marked ground

Steer to the green patch northwest of our starting position, then select Neutral. Neutral removes engine thrust; we still drift. The sounder measures water depth directly beneath the boat.

Chart & notes
Skip this step
Skip tutorial

records.name: keyboard-approach-accepted
records.lesson:
Frank · 6/10 · Put a diver to work

Use 1 to deploy Ada from the port rail here. Watch the diver enter and descend, then follow the bubbles while they collect a little catch.

Chart & notes
Skip this step
Skip tutorial

records.name: real-marked-catch
records.lesson:
Frank · 7/10 · Bring them alongside

Follow the bubbles. Use 3 near them, or wait for a float. 1 would deploy Milo now.

Chart & notes
Skip this step
Skip tutorial

records.name: empty-search-recovery-guidance
records.lesson:
Frank · 6/10 · Bring the float alongside

Bring each float beside the green PORT rail — the left side facing the bow. Select Neutral and use 1 to bring the diver aboard. Then we can try the marked shelf again; stay near any bubbles still in the water.

Skip this step
